description: Source code for UnboundHandler class implementing chat completion handling with integrations for different models and caching strategies.

classes.name: UnboundHandler
classes.description: A class that manages chat completion requests to the Unbound API, supporting streaming and non-streaming modes, with model fetching and caching logic.

methods.name: fetchModel
methods.description: Fetches available models from the Unbound API and updates internal model list.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the current model configuration, selecting default if necessary.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a streaming chat message, handling model-specific caching and tool support, yielding response chunks.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt with the current model, returning the generated text.
